steps.name: probe-and-skeleton
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/trading tests/waitlist -q --cov=src/trading/repositories --cov=src/waitlist --cov-report=json:.coverage.harness.json

cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/trading/test_live_signal_repositories.py tests/waitlist/test_waitlist_repository.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 6
